description: Official M-C limits (Ranked Battles and the VGC Tournament Handbook §4.3.1): 90 s Team Preview, 45 s per turn, 7 min player time, 20 min game time, enforced automatically at Championship Series events. Showdown's `VGC Timer` allows 55 s per turn and has no game clock, so it is more lenient per turn and never ends a game on total game time (an exhausted 7-min bank still forfeits the player). The game's behaviour on turn timeout and on game-time expiry is unknown (format matrix U6). Headless A1 self-play runs no timer, so neither difference changes its results.
